name: Warmington Mill

layers.essential_history: [[r:Warmington Mill is recorded in the Domesday Book. The building you see now is later, and milling stopped in 1958.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Deeper history for this stop is still to be written.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: you check the mill's records against the estate's own.]]

puzzle.title: The missing sacks
puzzle.intro: [[c:PLACEHOLDER IDEA, for your approval. Compare the two records.]]
material: [[c:MILL DISPATCH RECORD: 12 sacks of grain sent to the estate.]]
[[c:A riverside delivery note, marked with the same sack symbol, shows two sacks sold to a private buyer.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:How many sacks are missing?]]
hints: [[c:Compare the number sent with the number received.]]
[[c:Subtract the smaller number from the larger.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Two sacks are missing, and the delivery note shows where they went. The grain accounts do not add up.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:This puzzle uses only the story text.]]

evidence: [[c:Mill record: 12 sacks sent, 10 received. Two went to a private buyer. The grain accounts do not reconcile.]]
